title: Disclaimer: General Information, Not Legal Advice
description: LegalCostGuides publishes general information about U.S. legal costs. It is not legal advice, creates no attorney-client relationship and may be out of date.
body:
General information only

The content on LegalCostGuides is general information about legal costs in the United States. It is not legal advice, it is not a substitute for a lawyer licensed in your state, and reading it does not create an attorney-client relationship. LegalCostGuides is not a law firm or a lawyer referral service.

Accuracy and dates

We cite the source for each figure and show when each page was last reviewed, but fees, statutes and court rules change, and local courts may charge different amounts. Confirm current figures with the court or agency before relying on them.

Calculators and planning kits

Our calculators perform arithmetic on the numbers you enter. Our planning kits help you organize information and compare quotes. Neither predicts the outcome or value of a legal matter, and neither replaces advice from a lawyer.

Third-party links

Links to courts, agencies, bar associations and providers such as LawDepot are provided for convenience. We are not responsible for their content or services.
